For entry rules, maybe combining signals from these indicators. Similarly, when RSI is oversold (below 30), MACD is below the signal line, and SAR indicates a reversal down to up, that's a buy signal.

Exit rules could involve taking profit when the price reverts to a moving average or when RSI moves back to neutral. Stop-loss can be based on volatility.
